purpose: Teach: 風貌/可憐/阿呆/ガマン/物々交換/生まれ変わっ/とやかく/おのれ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは穏やかな風貌で安心するわね
lines.en: Sho, your dad has such a calm face — it's really reassuring.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone with genuine fondness. Soft opening, as if noticing something true about him. Gentle pace, almost thinking aloud. No rush to the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、可憐な蝶々見たよ
lines.en: Big sister Mei! I saw the most beautiful butterfly today!
lines.style: Bright, urgent energy from the start. Quick clip on the first syllable. Voice full of excitement and the need to share immediately. Pitch lifts on the discovery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、阿呆呼ばわりはお父さんに失礼よ
lines.en: Sho, calling your dad a fool isn't kind to him.
lines.style: Gentle but clear correction. Not scolding — more like guiding. Slight pause before the redirection, giving him space to understand. Warm underneath the firmness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、おやつのガマンができるようになったよ
lines.en: Big sister Mei! I can hold back from snacks now — I really can!
lines.style: Proud and eager to report. Energy builds through the line. Quick attack on the opening, sustaining brightness through the claim. The thrill of having done something hard.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんと小物の物々交換しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, how about you and I trade some small things together?
lines.style: Soft, inviting tone. Slow enough to feel like an offering, not a demand. Warmth in the middle registers. Trailing slightly upward at the end like a gentle question.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、心が生まれ変わった気分だよ
lines.en: Big sister Mei! It feels like my heart was born all over again!
lines.style: Wide-eyed wonder in the delivery. The opening bursts with innocent joy. Slower middle — savoring the feeling. Slight breathiness through the transformation phrase.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、人の事をとやかく言うのはやめましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's not say mean things about other people, okay?
lines.style: Patient guidance without heaviness. Mid-range tone, steady. The rhythm is a gentle teaching rhythm. A small pause after the thought, letting it settle in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、おのれを律することを学んだよ
lines.en: Big sister Mei! I've learned to have discipline over myself now.
lines.style: Earnest and sincere, the brightness tempered by real maturity. Deliberate pacing. Slight huskiness in the voice — the earnestness of a child speaking truth. Gentle close.
